import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from solution import query_specimens


class QuerySpecimensTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.records = [
            {"id": 2, "name": "River Fern", "collector": "Mira", "notes": "Green", "habitat": "wet", "year": 2020},
            {"id": "10", "name": "Stonecap", "collector": "FERN team", "notes": "rare", "habitat": "dry", "year": 2022},
            {"id": 1, "name": "Fern Moss", "collector": "Oren", "notes": "old", "habitat": "wet", "year": 2022},
            {"id": 2, "name": "Duplicate Fern", "collector": "Zed", "notes": "later duplicate", "habitat": "wet", "year": 2030},
            {"id": 3, "name": "Lichen", "collector": "Ivy", "notes": "contains FERN spores", "habitat": "wet", "year": 2019},
        ]

    def test_filter_deduplicate_sort_and_paginate(self):
        original = deepcopy(self.records)
        result = query_specimens(self.records, text="fErN", page=1, page_size=2)
        self.assertEqual(result["total"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(result["pages"], 2)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]], [1, "10"])

        second = query_specimens(self.records, text="fern", page=2, page_size=2)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in second["items"]], [2, 3])
        self.assertEqual(second["items"][0]["year"], 2020)
        self.assertEqual(self.records, original)

    def test_habitat_empty_results_and_out_of_range(self):
        wet = query_specimens(self.records, habitat="wet", page_size=10)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in wet["items"]], [1, 2, 3])
        self.assertEqual(wet["total"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(wet["pages"], 1)

        none = query_specimens(self.records, text="not present")
        self.assertEqual(none, {"items": [], "total": 0, "pages": 0})

        beyond = query_specimens(self.records, page=9, page_size=2)
        self.assertEqual(beyond["items"], [])
        self.assertEqual(beyond["total"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(beyond["pages"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(query_specimens([], page=1), {"items": [], "total": 0, "pages": 0})

    def test_returned_records_are_deep_copies(self):
        records = [{"id": 1, "name": "A", "collector": "B", "notes": "C", "habitat": {"zone": [1]}, "year": 2000}]
        result = query_specimens(records)
        result["items"][0]["habitat"]["zone"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["habitat"], {"zone": [1]})

    def test_invalid_paging_and_malformed_records(self):
        for page, page_size in [(0, 1), (-1, 1), (1, 0), (1, -2), (True, 1), (1, False), (1.5, 1), (1, "4")]:
            with self.subTest(page=page, page_size=page_size):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    query_specimens([], page=page, page_size=page_size)

        valid = {"id": 1, "name": "n", "collector": "c", "notes": "x", "habitat": "h", "year": 2000}
        malformed = [
            None,
            {"id": 1},
            dict(valid, name=3),
            dict(valid, collector=None),
            dict(valid, notes=[]),
            dict(valid, year="2000"),
            dict(valid, year=True),
        ]
        for record in malformed:
            with self.subTest(record=record):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    query_specimens([record])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
